# Review

`social-proof/review` &middot; content-level &middot; category: social-proof

## Purpose

One customer review: stars, an optional title, the review text, and who wrote it.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rating` | number |  |
| `body` | text |  |
| `customer` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | text |  |
| `product` | text |  |
| `date` | text |  |
| `verified` | boolean |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Left-aligned review with title.
- **centered**: Centered review. Sets `align: center`.
- **compact**: No title, just stars, text and the reviewer. Sets `showTitle: false`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `showTitle` | boolean | `true` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Star glyphs from the system symbol font, text honored. | Fine. | Text swaps via dm-text and dm-muted where honored. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('social-proof/review', {
  "rating": 5,
  "title": "Softer with every wash",
  "body": "I have owned it for a year and it still looks new. The fit is exactly what I hoped for.",
  "customer": "Priya N.",
  "product": "Coastal Linen Shirt",
  "verified": true
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "social-proof/review",
  "data": {
    "rating": 5,
    "title": "Softer with every wash",
    "body": "I have owned it for a year and it still looks new. The fit is exactly what I hoped for.",
    "customer": "Priya N.",
    "product": "Coastal Linen Shirt",
    "verified": true
  }
}
```
